text:
deploybot: Planned quiet cutover: /api/v2 -> edges. Start=2026-05-05T00:30:00Z. Initial pct=3%. Canary region: sa-east. Pins: enterprise-10, enterprise-11. Release notes draft: https://rwd.in/notes/v2-quiet :book:
sam: ack. I'll own release notes sign-off and customer comms if we go green.
liam: infra warmup done. edge pools warmed, cache primed. autoscale = same as v1.
sre-bot: preflight ok. watch windows: first 10m tight, then 40m relaxed. Alerts for 5xx > 0.3% and p95 > 130ms.
release-lead: confirmed pin list. small breaking note about header normalization and a rerank schema tweak added.
10m later
deploybot: executing shift: moving 3% to v2 in sa-east. route sync ok.
sre-bot: alert: 5xx spike 0.5% in sa-east for 2m. link: https://rwd.in/alerts/ALRT-2601
liam: seeing 502s from edge->modelpool, likely connection resets from proxy group gamma.
release-lead: threshold to pause = pinned client signals >1% or 5xx >0.4% for 3m. We're at 0.5% but 2m. hold and observe 3m?
kate_ops: holding. deploybot: pause increases (no rollback).
deploybot: acknowledged. Pausing further pct increases; current exposure remains 3%.
3m later
sre-bot: 5xx sustained 0.6% for 4m. recommend partial rollback for sa-east.
liam: reproducing in staging: header lowercasing in v2 interacts poorly with our proxy keepalive hashing. will patch client lib.
sam: initiate partial rollback sa-east -> v1 and update release notes to note paused canary.
deploybot: running rollback: `/deploy rollback --region sa-east --target v1 --reason "5xx spike during v2 canary"`
5m later
deploybot: rollback complete for sa-east. 5xx back to baseline (0.02%). Global v2 exposure now 2%.
sre-bot: canary marked failed for sa-east. state saved: rollout_id=hold-1799991111, paused=true.
liam: will post repro steps and patched image to the ticket. propose resume plan: 1) patch + staging green 2) slow push 1% increments every 10m with extended watch windows 3) explicit approve from @release-lead and @sre.
sam: agree. I'll update release notes and CS comms recommending SDK bump for clients.
kate_ops: tenant notify sent to owners for transparency. pinned tenants unaffected.
release-lead: good catch. hold full rollout until patch + clean staging e2e. To resume: `/deploy resume rollout_id=hold-1799991111 --approve @release-lead @sre`
sre-bot: marking rollout paused. saving watches and alerts.
sam: thanks team — will close loop when staging green. :white_check_mark:
